name: chatgpt-remote-commander
description: Operate a trusted computer through private MCP, with audited opt-in Windows screen/mouse/keyboard control.

interface.longDescription: Use the exact registered ChatGPT Remote Commander app to inspect projects, run trusted-machine workflows, and optionally control an authorized Windows desktop. GUI work uses an exclusive short-lived lease, a live screenshot frame, one bounded input action, and a fresh screenshot for visible verification.
defaultPrompt: Report this computer's Remote Commander status without changing anything.
Inspect my project and explain what needs attention before making changes.
Use Remote Commander to run the requested trusted-machine workflow.
For a graphical task, verify gui_status, acquire gui_session_begin, inspect gui_screenshot, use exactly one lease+frame action, capture again to verify the visible result, and end the GUI session.
